title: Circlet of Fire

sources.title: Fiery Return
markers: | description = When you deal {{DamageType|Fire}} damage with a levelled spell, you {{Cond|Burning|Burn}} yourself and gain an additional {{r|bonus}} this round.

summary: Qualifying Fire spells and melee spell attacks grant a Bonus Action and make you Burn for 2 turns.

fields.Fiery Return: Deal Fire damage with a leveled spell or melee spell attack to gain a Bonus Action this round and become Burning for 2 turns. A cantrip can qualify if it uses a melee spell attack, such as Fire Bolt with Daredevil Gloves.
fields.Availability: Early Access only. The launch version does not include this item.
fields.Base value: 220 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Reported behavior: Searing Smite fails to trigger it. A qualifying Bonus Action can spend the extra Bonus Action as soon as it is granted.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
